text_block_list.text:
On this day, Vodka and the others were participating
in a pre-shoot for a special magazine feature.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Muses wearing racing racewear
to express the "World of Beauty Sasami".
I look forward to reading this special feature every year!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
!
We'll make sure to capture the absolute best photos
of all you muses this year as well!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the other muses are in it too!
Mayano, Fine... Man, as expected,
everyone looks super cute—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Which means I'll be looking like this too...?
...Well, dresses in a church, of course it'd be like that.)

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You can stay in your school uniforms for today's shoot.
Let's wear something comfortable and find that wonderful shot together!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah—!! I'm gonna find
the ultimate one-shot during today's test shoot... just watch me!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! Won't know till we try.
Let's make it our own!!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Both of you look ridiculously cute!
I'm already excited for the real shoot~~!!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, perfect! Totally number one!
Next up is Hishi Amazon-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Uh-huh... If I remember right, Rice did
that princess-like pose, kinda like this...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No, wait! That's not it, Rice didn't do it like this!
It was more like—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heheh, ngggh...?!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on, stop! Forcing difficult poses might hurt you!
Relax your shoulders a bit more, like this...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Ama & ???
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaah~~! I get it in my head, but still!
Gaaah~~! I understand it in my head, but damn it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: !? That voice—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Dammit all—!!
It's not working at aalll~!!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman B
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... To bring out your charm, Vodka-san,
let's try out a few different things!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
! Even if I ain't used to it,
I wanna do my best, like switching up the location or whatever...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...So she's struggling too, just like me.
Being cute is way harder than I thought...!

Thus, Hishi Amazon and Vodka continued shooting
while wrestling with their troubles. However—

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
It's about time to wrap up! Today was just a test shoot,
so please do your best for the real shoot...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Sorry about today.
I'll get my revenge on the day of the real shoot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ............Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Just... could you take just one more shot of me, please?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I still wanna aim for it.
A shot that'll blow away both the people looking and myself—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So I can nail that strongest best shot
right on target during the real shoot...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's right...
It's not like "Oh well, nothing we could do today."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Shoot me too! If I leave things feeling hazy like this,
there's no way the real shoot'll go well either!

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Hishi Ama
text_block_list.text:
!!
We're counting on you!!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Editor
text_block_list.text:
...Understood! Let's do everything we possibly can
toward getting that best shot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Hishi Ama
text_block_list.text:
YES!!!!
YEAH!!!!

One day on the way back from work.
I spotted Vodka and Hishi Amazon talking seriously.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we couldn't settle on the best shot.
...Gotta get it in shape somehow before the real shoot!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's prepare with all our might
and make it the absolute best magazine feature!!

It seems the two of them have an important event coming up.
I quietly cheered for them in my heart.
